title: Learner-State-Aware Generative User Interfaces: code, data and results
description: Code, simulation outputs and measurements for the paper "Learner-State-Aware Generative User Interfaces: A Closed-Loop Control Architecture for Adaptive Learning Environments". Bayesian Knowledge Tracing estimates mastery, a PID governor turns it into a structural complexity budget, a rule-based policy selects scaffolding, a deterministic planner fixes the layout, and a foundation model (Gemini 3.7 Flash) writes the content as a JSON component tree behind a validation gate. Includes the 1,000-learner in-silico benchmark, controller tuning and sensitivity runs, the real-Gemini plant measurements, the React CLT-UI testbed and the LaTeX manuscript. All evaluation is in silico; there are no human-subject results.
